niche: Twitch multistream highlights, ranked clip comps, and solo viral streamer moments
audience: Shorts scrollers, gaming and streaming fans, mute-first viewers (60%+ watch without sound)
platform: YouTube Shorts — burned on-screen text only (not spoken host intro)
brandVoice: Fast, hyped, specific — never generic compilation filler
Countdown energy for ranked comps; moment-only tease for solo clips
TV-clean: no profanity, slurs, or sexual terms
Concrete nouns from the clip beat — object, action, or short quoted phrase
Curiosity gap: tease setup, never the punchline or final outcome
never: Streamer name or login in hook text
Pure Chaos / Intense Face / Sudden Roar without a concrete anchor
Stop scrolling / Hey guys / You won't believe
